title: Retrieval manifest, version 3 (osd.manifest/3; osd.manifest/1 and /2 still validate)
description: What a person selected from the catalogue and where its files are. Written by `osd manifest` (and, later, the site), read by `osd get` and `osd.manifest.read`. Assets are the STAC Collection assets, which are the files the verifier hashed: a sample, never the whole dataset unless `coverage` says complete. Never carries credentials. v2 (E07): an asset may name `alternates`, other locations of the same bytes (the mirror), tried before `href`; a manifest with alternates says osd.manifest/2, one without may stay osd.manifest/1. v3 (E09): `metadata.catalog` names the catalogue snapshot the manifest was written from (records.json `catalog`, copied whole); a /3 manifest carries it, /1 and /2 must not. A /3 licence may state `attribution: null` (the source states no value), which /1 and /2 refuse.

catalog_url.description: The STAC root the ids resolve against

selection.description: Collection selection or Item selection, never a mix

metadata.description: v3. About the manifest itself: the catalogue snapshot it was written from

catalog.description: The catalogue snapshot, copied whole from records.json `catalog`. records_digest is the sha256 of the records array as canonical JSON: keys sorted, separators ',' and ':', UTF-8, no escaping of non-ASCII

source_commit.description: Commit of the repository the catalogue was built from; null outside git

verification_commit.description: Commit of the verification-results branch the levels came from; null when the build was not told

href.description: http(s), no userinfo, no signature or token in the query

file:checksum.description: Multihash as the STAC File extension states it; osd get accepts sha2-256 (1220…) only and refuses others loudly

alternates.description: v2. Name ("mirror") to another location of the same bytes, from the STAC Alternate Assets extension; the checksum above covers every location

licence.description: The record's licence object, copied whole; absent fields stay absent (unknown), nothing is invented

attribution.description: v3 admits null: the source states no value; a reader treats it as not stated and supplies no default

item_id.description: Item selection: the STAC Item id, or null when the feature has no Item

feature_id.description: Item selection: the map feature that was selected

origin_url.description: The publisher's page; the to-do address when assets are empty

known_issues.description: The record's known_issues, verbatim (publisher restrictions live here and in licence.redistribution)

assets.description: STAC asset key (a relative path) to asset; keys become paths under --dest/<collection_id>/

coverage.description: sampled: the files the verifier hashed, not the whole dataset

unresolved.description: Why no asset is listed; the origin page is the to-do
